row.body: The gate key is pinned under a closure notice dated after the guard shift ended. Someone wedged a bat across the latch from the inside.
row.title: The unfinished handoff

sidecar.gloss: A gate closure appears after the listed shift, with the inside latch still blocked.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program site could also have been closed to visitors; the late notice and blocked gate do not identify who ordered it.
